{{Quote|The first time I heard of Vimran Trell, I though ''[sic]'' to myself, 'What could a cook possibly do for us?' When the ''Adjudicator'' was sent to destroy a Rebel base, Trell proved his worth by warning Alliance agents. The ''Adjudicator'' found only a few deserted buildings. My opinion changed. And for those of you who haven't tried his Fromirian roast queg, you won't understand Moff Renquet's decision.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to Vimran Trell|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Fromirian roast queg''' was a gourmet [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] that originated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Fromiria system/Legends|Fromiria system]]. [[Yeoman/Legends|Yeoman]] [[Vimran Trell]] of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']], who was also a qualified [[Chef/Legends|chef]], once made the dish for a reception that, around [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], was held aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|warship]] and included [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Renquet]]. The latter was so impressed with the [[Diet/Legends|meal]] that he subsequently had the ''Adjudicator'' become the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of his [[Sector fleet/Legends|sector fleet]].

==Description==
Fromirian roast queg was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]]<ref name="CRO" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Fromiria system/Legends|Fromiria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was prepared during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[Vimran Trell]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Yeoman/Legends|yeoman]] serving aboard the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]]<ref name="CRO" /> [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']]&mdash;and originally a qualified gourmet [[Chef/Legends|chef]] hailing from<ref name="CRO" /> the Mortex [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Yutusk">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Yutusk system/Legends|Yutusk system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Yutusk]]. There, Trell had been raised toward taking over the small gourmet [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] of his [[Francill Trell|father]], a plan that was disrupted by the former's unexpected conscription in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
[[File:Vimran_Trell_CSO.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Fromirian roast queg was prepared by Vimran Trell.]]
At one point around [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]],<ref name="4 BBY" /> the ''Adjudicator'' was poised to host a reception for several dignitaries including Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Renquet]]. Since the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|warship's]] galley chef was on medical leave at the [[Time/Legends|time]], Trell let the ''Adjudicator''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Krin]] know of his culinary qualifications. The yeoman went on to prepare a [[Diet/Legends|meal]] for the reception that included a Fromirian roast queg. Renquet was extremely pleased with the dish, to the extent that he requested that the ''Adjudicator'' be transferred as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of his [[Sector fleet/Legends|sector fleet]].<ref name="CRO" />

After Trell had come into contact with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and become an undercover Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] at some point by the time shortly following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Human Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] also tasted the Fromirian roast queg prepared by him. Cracken similarly enjoyed the meal and eventually noted it in an entry of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives dedicated to Trell. In the entry, Cracken further claimed that the quality of the dish rendered Renquet's decision regarding the appointment of the ''Adjudicator'' as his flagship understandable.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fromirian roast queg was created by [[David R. Tulo, Jr.]] and [[Ron Hodge]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" />
